title: One Loss Resolves Signed Rank-One Gradient Fibers: computational artifacts
description: Exact reconstruction code, synthetic inputs and complete computational outcomes for manuscript jsc-strengthened-2026.10.26.9. Adds independent observed-edge Singular reconstruction, exact cross-RUR checks, a unified 126-run solver comparison and all 288 phase records. The primary 420-file snapshot and its results are preserved. This archive is software and data, not the journal article.
